title: PRISMA: Plan-Retrieve-Inspect-Solve-Memoize Architecture for Real-World Open-Domain Multi-Hop Question Answering

defines.name: PRISMA
defines.definition: A decoupled RL-guided multi-agent framework for open-domain multi-hop QA that coordinates planning, retrieval, inspection, solving, and memoization to improve evidence-grounded reasoning.

problem: Real-world multi-hop RAG systems suffer from retrieval collapse and unstable end-to-end learning, making it hard to reliably find intermediate evidence and generalize across benchmarks.
